title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Nagin Ka Inteqam
desc: A gang of poachers forcibly try to obtain a stone from two snakes and end up killing one while the other escapes. The second snake then uses a young girl to avenge the death of her partner.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest man, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for raping a woman. Consequently, Baburao leaves no stone unturned to get revenge against Prithviraj.

title: Zakhmi Sipahi
desc: Shakti is an honest police officer out to avenge the death of his father. He faces many trials and tribulations in his journey towards fulfilling this task.

title: Radhe
desc: Radhe, a daredevil encounter specialist of the Mumbai Police force, vows to knock down the crime syndicate led by an evil drug lord.

title: Rathnam
desc: Rathnam, a henchman for MLA Panner Selvam, rescues a girl from attackers during her interview trip to Vellore. As he becomes her protector, he wonders how long he can keep her safe.
